leadText: Volume 7: From the Heart is the seventh of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.
plainText:
Volume 7: From the Heart is the seventh of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.

==Blurb==
IN THIS VOLUME…
Bonus stories and features never before printed in English!
A mysterious beauty appears and threatens to take Gramps away from his enemies—er, friends—if he doesn't invent something that actually works!
Clefairy and Pikachu make friends and enemies under the sea…but it's hard to tell which is which!
Eevee and Little Lu go on their first date, and everything goes smoothly and according to plan…NOT!
Hazel and Coconut must rescue Almond when he falls into a mysterious deep sleep and can't wake up.
Sandy and Raichu return for a guest appearance.
PLUS, more stories starring Qwilfish, a bed of Shellder, Hypno, Drowzee, Misdreavus, Quagsire, and all your most favorite characters!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
The Mysterious Beauty
Swimming with the Qwilfish
The Very First Date
Heavenly Pokémon
Clefairy's Blue Period
Rock-a-Bye Pokémon (Part 1)
Rock-a-Bye Pokémon (Part 2)
The Hill of the Lone Star Tree
Jigglypuff's Joy

 
==Trivia==
===Errors===
In the VIZ Media release, the Pokémon File swaps Gramps and 's portraits.
